reviewText: The mechanical sound design is absolutely top-tier. Every click feels so satisfying, and the puzzles are genuinely clever without being frustrating.
Finally a puzzle game that respects my intelligence! The gear logic is brilliant and the visuals of the brass dials are stunning on my phone.
Game is good but the later levels get super tough. Thoda gear ratio samajhne mein time lag raha hai, but design achha hai.
